Messages.Author: François
Messages.Body:
Hello,

I need a few clarifications about 2 unrelated cards :

Sanguine Instruction : can a Caitiff play it ? (I guess he can't,
since Caitiff is not a clan, so no "same clan" requirement can be
met).

Lesser Boon : Master: out-of-turn. Boon.
Only usable when a minion you control successfully blocks. The action
resolves as if unblocked. Put this card on the acting minion. This
minion cannot block your minions. Burn this card if you block this
minion again, or when this minion's controller has less than 6 pool.

I guess "resolving as if unblocked" implies there is no block-combat,
is it right ?
Does this leave the blocking minion untapped ?
Can the blocking minion play inferior Cats' Guidance ?
If no reaction card was played, does the acting minion gains a blood
from perfectionnist ?
Can he play Forced March ?
Could he play superior freak drive (let's imagine he really needs to
leave the vampire untapped with 2 less blood and Slow Withering is in
play) ?

Thank you,

François
